# OKR Rollout Readiness Checklist

Documentation HQ: [README](../../README.md)

Use this checklist before pilot start and before each scale wave.

## 1. Organization Readiness

| Check | Status (`Yes/No`) | Notes/Owner |
|---|---|---|
| Vision/strategy is clear enough to derive Objectives |  |  |
| Leaders agree OKRs are not direct individual performance ratings |  |  |
| Leadership style supports coaching and blocker removal |  |  |
| Change communication is approved and scheduled |  |  |
| Works council or equivalent stakeholders are informed (if applicable) |  |  |

## 2. Team Readiness

| Check | Status (`Yes/No`) | Notes/Owner |
|---|---|---|
| Pilot teams are selected with readiness rationale |  |  |
| Managers are trained on cadence and quality expectations |  |  |
| Teams can run weekly check-ins reliably |  |  |
| Teams can own strategic outcomes, not only tasks |  |  |
| Teams can distinguish BAU work from strategic change work |  |  |
| BAU assignment system is defined (for example Odoo/ticketing/paper) |  |  |
| Cross-team dependencies are visible and managed |  |  |

## 3. Process Readiness

| Check | Status (`Yes/No`) | Notes/Owner |
|---|---|---|
| Pilot goals, scope, and parameters are documented in writing |  |  |
| Success criteria and thresholds are defined before cycle start |  |  |
| Planning/check-in/review/retro dates are pre-scheduled |  |  |
| BAU release policy is adopted (`SHIFT` test + release log) |  |  |
| Objective wording quality gate is in use (outcome-state statements, not single-metric lines) |  |  |
| KR wording quality gate is in use (`baseline/current/target/time` present for each KR) |  |  |
| Retro format is standardized (`Start/Stop/Continue` or equivalent) |  |  |
| Decision process for scale/no-scale is documented |  |  |

## 4. Role Readiness

| Check | Status (`Yes/No`) | Notes/Owner |
|---|---|---|
| `OKR Executive Sponsor` is assigned |  |  |
| `OKR Project Lead` is assigned |  |  |
| `OKR HR/People Lead` is assigned |  |  |
| `OKR Coach/Master` capacity matches number of teams |  |  |
| Manager cohort has clear accountabilities |  |  |

## 5. Product/Data Readiness (This Repository)

| Check | Status (`Yes/No`) | Notes/Owner |
|---|---|---|
| Roles are configured correctly (`admin/manager/member`) |  |  |
| Manager links are configured (`manager_id`) |  |  |
| Active cycle is selected and visible |  |  |
| Teams can access Weekly Ritual and submit KR check-ins |  |  |
| Dashboard and report views are available for governance |  |  |
| Lifecycle states are used consistently (`DRAFT/ACTIVE/GRADING/ARCHIVED`) |  |  |
| BAU release log is reviewed in manager governance rhythm |  |  |

## 6. Scale Wave Readiness

| Check | Status (`Yes/No`) | Notes/Owner |
|---|---|---|
| Pilot retrospective findings are documented |  |  |
| Survey feedback has been collected and reviewed |  |  |
| Improvement actions from prior cycle are tracked |  |  |
| Next-wave teams are selected by readiness, not convenience |  |  |
| Champions/ambassadors are assigned from pilot participants |  |  |

## 7. Final Gate

Outcome:
- `Ready to launch`
- `Ready with conditions`
- `Not ready`

Conditions (if any):
